notes: All five records a round-56 agent returned on the revolving door, filed as returned. Two close places that held only public moves and so rendered blank: Colombia, where the hiring-firm route worked after the bank's own biographies had been read and found entirely public, and Guyana, where earlier rounds read the hiring banks' board LISTING pages while Demerara Bank also publishes per-person director profiles. Three more are places that held nothing at all: Albania, Georgia and Moldova. MOLDOVA IS A JUDGEMENT CALL recorded on the face of the record: the outside employers are private audit and advisory practices, Ernst & Young and Baker Tilly, rather than banks, insurers or brokers. It is filed as counting, on the reasoning that the map already treats the audit firms behind central banks as private financial actors -- an entire pattern on the map is about the four firms that audit them, and the official moved from auditing into banking supervision. If a later round decides the row should count only banks, insurers, brokers and funds, reverse it on that reasoning and say so rather than quietly dropping it. ALBANIA AND GEORGIA both carry MIXED ownership stated on the face: Societe Generale's own capital breakdown shows a free float of 72.72 per cent with no French state stake and one public financial institution at 2.22 per cent, and ProCredit Holding's own shareholder page names Zeitinger Invest, KfW, DOEN and the EBRD. TWO RECORDS WERE HELD for want of an ownership fact, both on the Zambia trap where a hiring bank turned out to be state-owned. Montenegro: Vice-Governor Gordana Kalezic was Director of the AML and CFT Unit at Azmont Bank AD Podgorica from 2016 to 2019, per the central bank's own dated page, but Azmont's parent Azerbaijan Global Investments is itself unclassified and Azmont's PREVIOUS parent was SOCAR, the Azerbaijani state oil company -- the closing route is the CRPS registry or a central bank shareholder disclosure. South Korea: the YEAR is now settled at 2021, from the Asiae report of an extraordinary shareholders' meeting on 2 July 2021 which also confirms the 1987 Bank of Korea entry and the Deputy Governor post, but ownership of Seoul Money Brokerage Services is still not established and the company's own site would not resolve. A telling negative the agent found: the comparable Korean brokerage, Korea Money Brokerage, publishes its ownership as 17 commercial banks at 39 per cent, the state resolution company KR&C at 22.1 per cent, 19 securities companies at 21 per cent and insurers at 4 per cent -- so even the 'consortium of banks' assumption would land on mixed ownership with a state block, which is exactly why silence cannot be read as private. NORTH MACEDONIA is still not filable: only the same CV surfaced and the firm and industry remain withheld. NEW CONFIRMED BLANKS: Mozambique, whose central bank publishes a fully dated board CV that is entirely public and whose largest commercial bank's chair has no central bank role in the hiring firm's own announcement.

records.people: Gent Sejko (Governor and Chairman of the Supervisory Council)
records.move: from Deputy General Manager of Societe Generale Albania to Governor of the Bank of Albania (5 February 2015), after senior executive and committee-chairing roles at the National Commercial Bank, the American Bank of Albania and Raiffeisen Bank
records.summary: The Bank of Albania's own biography page for Gent Sejko states he has been Governor and Chairman of the Supervisory Council since 5 February 2015, was re-elected for a second term on 24 February 2022, and that prior to his appointment as Governor he served as Deputy General Manager of Societe Generale Albania, having earlier held senior executive positions and chaired committees at the National Commercial Bank, the American Bank of Albania and Raiffeisen Bank, with responsibilities spanning corporate and retail banking, audit and compliance, and leasing; Societe Generale is a private commercial and investment bank in finance, and its own investor-relations capital breakdown as of 31 December 2025 shows 72.72% free float, 9.11% employee shareholding, 14.39% held by asset managers (BlackRock 7.93%, Amundi 2.70%, Capital Group 2.33%, BNPP AM 1.43%), 1.57% treasury and one public financial institution, Caisse des Depots et Consignations, at 2.22%, with no French State stake listed, so ownership is predominantly private with a small public minority - that ownership fact comes from investors.societegenerale.com, not from the Bank of Albania page, which only calls the employers the commercial banking sector.
records.source_title: Mr. Gent Sejko, Governor of the Bank of Albania

records.people: Nino Jeladze (Vice-Governor and member of the Board)
records.move: from JSC ProCredit Bank Georgia and ProCredit Holding (Frankfurt) to the National Bank of Georgia, where she became Head of the Supervisory Policy Department in 2024 and Vice-Governor on 10 February 2025
records.summary: The National Bank of Georgia's own board-member profile page for Nino Jeladze gives a fully dated career: account manager at JSC ProCredit Bank Georgia in 2003, head of its customer service department 2004-2005, branch manager including of the central branch 2006-2014, operational risk manager 2014-2015, operational risk manager at ProCredit Holding in Frankfurt 2015-2017, head of anti-money laundering and compliance at JSC ProCredit Bank Georgia 2017-2021, consultant in private practice 2022-2023, then head of the NBG's Supervisory Policy Department 2024-2025 and Vice-Governor and board member since 10 February 2025 for a term to February 2032; the employer is a commercial bank and so is in finance, and its ownership is mixed rather than state - ProCredit Holding's own shareholder-structure page names Zeitinger Invest GmbH, Kreditanstalt fuer Wiederaufbau (KfW, the German state development bank), DOEN Participaties and the EBRD as the reporting shareholders of the listed German group, so the ownership fact comes from procredit-holding.com and is stated here as mixed private, state-development and multilateral.
records.source_title: Nino Jeladze - Member of the Board of the National Bank of Georgia, Vice-Governor

records.people: Rajendra Rampersaud (Director at the Bank of Guyana)
records.move: from Director at the Bank of Guyana (until 2018) to Director of Demerara Bank Limited
records.summary: Demerara Bank Limited's own director profile page for Mr. Rajendra Rampersaud, published on its board-members listing dated 21 September 2022, states that he has over two decades of central banking experience and served as Director at the Bank of Guyana until 2018, holds master's degrees in monetary economics and finance from the University of Glasgow and in economics and planning from Moscow, and has contributed to the Inter-American Development Bank and the Caribbean Development Bank, and it lists him as a Director of the bank; the hiring employer is in finance and is private, and that ownership fact comes from Demerara Bank Limited's own audited Annual Report 2023, note 1 Incorporation and business activities, which states that the bank was incorporated on 20 January 1992 as a private limited liability company under the Companies Act Chapter 89:01 and was licensed to carry on the business of banking on 31 October 1994.
records.source_title: Mr. Rajendra Rampersaud, Director - Demerara Bank Limited

records.people: Gerardo Hernandez Correa (codirector of the Banco de la Republica, executive manager and secretary of its Board)
records.move: from codirector, executive manager and secretary of the Board of the Banco de la Republica to vice-president of legal affairs at Banco de Bogota from 2021 ; to president of Banco AV Villas, announced 27 June 2024
records.summary: La Republica's report of 27 June 2024 states that Gerardo Hernandez Correa will become president of Banco AV Villas, replacing Juan Camilo Angel, that he spent sixteen years at the Banco de la Republica in roles including codirector (board member), executive manager and secretary of the Board, that he was Superintendente Financiero of Colombia for six years, and that immediately before the AV Villas appointment he had been vice-president of legal affairs at Banco de Bogota since 2021; both hiring employers are commercial banks and so are in finance, and both are private rather than state - the same article states that Grupo Aval holds controlling stakes in financial entities including Banco AV Villas, and Grupo Aval is a private financial conglomerate and not a state body, so the ownership fact comes from this article and not from any Banco de la Republica page.
records.source_title: Gerardo Hernandez sera el presidente del Banco AV Villas

records.people: Constantin Schendra (Deputy Governor and member of the Executive Committee)
records.move: from senior auditor at Ernst & Young Moldova (2010-2015) and Ernst & Young Cyprus (2013-2014) and executive director at Baker Tilly Moldova (2015-2018) to Director of the Banking Supervision Department of the National Bank of Moldova (2018-2021) and then Deputy Governor (4 November 2021)
records.summary: The National Bank of Moldova's own biography page for Constantin Schendra states that he was appointed Deputy Governor and member of the Executive Committee by Parliament decision no. 161 of 4 November 2021, that at the time of his appointment he had over 18 years of experience in the economic and banking sector including over eight years in international audit companies, and gives the dated sequence: accountant at the Center for Economic and Social Development from 2002, grant financial manager at Citizen Network for Foreign Affairs in 2005, regional director of the USAID Community Connections programme 2005-2010, senior auditor at Ernst & Young Moldova 2010-2015 and at Ernst & Young Cyprus 2013-2014, executive director at Baker Tilly Moldova 2015-2018, and Director of the NBM Banking Supervision Department 2018-2021; Ernst & Young and Baker Tilly are private firms and no state body is involved in them, but the page does not state their ownership and they are audit and advisory practices in financial services rather than banks, insurers, brokerages or funds, so the sector characterisation here rests on the National Bank's own words international audit companies and the map owner should judge whether a financial-services consultancy counts.
records.source_title: Mr. Constantin Schendra, Deputy Governor of the NBM
